$comment: EXP-1291 THE session card ×4 — a session inside a chat (the root's own session first, every child where its `session` card message sits, an agent channel's `thread_started` cards) is ONE card = the Work card's HEADER row (work-card.json geometry.header px, radius lg, card hairline, no shadow): the state `icon` (concept), the `name` (medium, truncates), the `kindWord`, trailing the muted `elapsed` (tabular figures) with a 12px spinner in front while `running`. No device, account, branch or other caption. Tapping it opens that session's raw view (today's session view). Model = pure `sessionCard(session, title, now)` (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/session-tree.ts; mirrors desktop domain::session_tree, iOS ExpCore SessionTree.swift, Android domain/SessionTree.kt), every mirror replays `cases` and compares the WHOLE expected object. S-3 (owner 2026-10-28): FOUR states, nothing else ×4 (no running, paused, interrupted, blocked or stale word): state = `done` when status ended, else `needs_you` when needsInput (a card, a usage wall, an unclaimed/stuck watchdog flag, a failed start; #FEED-235: `unclaimed` also flags a STARTED session whose online device ran no turn on its input, eagent watchdog.json UNDELIVERED, read with the same 'Not picked up' word), else `working` when status queued or busy (background tasks included), else `idle` (between turns; an INTERRUPTION, blocked.kind device_offline/restarted, is invisible: its row reads by busy). name = `title`, the session's display title (EXP-1341 session-title.json `sessionTitle`; never `Session N`). kindWord = `copy.states[state]`, except a `needs_you` session whose blocked.kind is in `copy.blockedKinds` reads that word (EXP-1536: blocked.kind start_failed = the device could not start the run after the claim; it reads `Couldn't start`, never Idle; the next report of the relaunch clears it). elapsed ONLY while working (startedAt → now; null while queued) or done (startedAt → endedAt, else updatedAt), the work card's ladder ('37s', '2m 04s', '1h 03m'); idle and needs_you carry none (never 'Waiting 158h'); null without a parsable startedAt. running = state working. tone = `tones[state]`, icon = `icons[state]`. #EXP-1466 (owner 2026-10-30) the tone ×4: the icon is painted in `tone` (foreground, amber or muted); the kindWord is muted EXCEPT an amber tone, which paints it amber too (`Needs you`, `Usage limit`, `Not picked up`, `Stuck`, `Couldn't start`; a `Working` word stays muted). amber = design-tokens `semantic.yellow` (#FACC15) on every platform (web `text-yellow-400`, desktop `tokens::YELLOW`, iOS / Android `DesignTokens.Semantic.yellow`). A chat-row-action.json `tone` override (`Answered`, muted) replaces the card's tone for both. The Dock card = `sessionBanner(session)` (dock.json `banner` source, one model x4: web agent-session.tsx useSessionDock, desktop steer_viewer, iOS AgentSessionModel, Android AgentSessionScreen): null when ended or needsInput; `queued` (status queued: waiting for its device, #EXP-1405) or `background` (busy AND background, EXP-1374) = {id, icon = bannerIcons[id], label = bannerLabels[id], text = banner[id], tone muted, action null}; any other = null (S-3: no interrupted and no paused card ×4); `bannerCases` replay it. #EXP-1405: an IDLE session (started, not busy, not ended) shows its transcript on every device, not only the one that ran it: its viewer ticket names the host device as `live` (web `viewerHistoryClaims`), the relay asks that device to replay its journal and keeps the room up while it is watched; any failure answers the retryable `no_such_session`, never an ending. #EXP-1703 (owner 2026-11-05) A DEVICE AWAY ON A PERSON: a session the watchdog put on a person because its device stayed offline (#EXP-1675: needsInput, blocked.kind device_offline, NO blocked.resumeSince: the device never came back) is `offline` (`sessionOffline(session)`): its card's kindWord = `copy.blockedKinds.device_offline` ('Device offline', amber like every needs_you word); once the device is back (resumeSince set) the flag reads plain `Needs you`. Its Dock card = `sessionBanner(session, deviceName)` {id offline, icon bannerIcons.offline, label bannerLabels.offline, text = banner.offline with {device} = the host device's name (null or unknown = `bannerDevice`, 'Its device'), tone warning, action = bannerActions.offline ('Move')}: the action opens the EXISTING device-move picker (session-device-move.json) on that session; the session continues by itself when its device is back (no Retry: the transcript redials on presence, steer-enet.json OFFLINE REDIAL). A plain interruption (no needsInput) stays invisible (S-3). `bannerCases` carry `deviceName` (absent = null). #NEW-49 WAITING (owner 2026-11-16, eagent wakeups.json WATCH EVENTS): S-3's four states stay; an IDLE session that waits on something reads it as its kindWord `copy.waiting` ('Waiting on {labels}', muted like Idle). `sessionWaiting(watching, children)` = the labels: its LIVE children's names (tree order, the names their cards show), then its `sessions.watching` labels (a watched session that is also a listed child once; the server writes each label: an issue identifier, a title, 'CI #1130', '#1130', 'EXP-12', '14:30 UTC', 'a private chat'), each label once, the first `waitingMax` joined by ', ' and `copy.waitingMore` (' +{count}') for the rest; null = nothing (Idle). `sessionCard(session, title, now, waiting)` takes it; `waitingCases` replay it, `cases` with `waiting` the card. The thread list row (chat-list.json `waiting`), the thread header (session-screen.json) and the Dock (dock.json `watches`) say the same. #EXP-1943 (2026-11-18, phase 4, the drafts Danny approved) A CALL IN THE CHAT = ONE CARD, THE CALL'S OWN VIEW. A call session (etalk voice-call.json `callSession`: a child of the agent chat whose `sessions.voice_call` is non-null, synced in the sessions shape; the session's `voiceCall` = {startedAt, segmentStartedAt, endedAt, durationMs}) shows in its chat as THIS session card, never as bubbles: its `session` card message (posted when the call started) is the ONE row of the call, for a resumed call too (the same session, the same card). `callCard(session, summary, now)` (`callCases`, every mirror compares the WHOLE object): icon `call.icon` (`voice-call`), tone `call.tone`, kindWord '' (none drawn), elapsed null, running false (no spinner), testId `testIds.card`. RUNNING (status not ended AND `voiceCall.endedAt` null): state `working`, name = `call.running` with {timer} = `callClock(durationMs + now - segmentStartedAt)` ('02:14', '1:02:14' past an hour; the card ticks every second like every running card), caption null (a device that is IN that call may show its call surface's phase word as the caption: voice-call.json copy.listening / thinking / speaking; the model never does). ENDED: state `done`, name = `call.ended` with {duration} = `callLength(durationMs)` (under a minute = `call.seconds` with the whole seconds; under an hour = `call.minutes` with the rounded minutes, at least 1; else `call.hours`), caption = `summary` (the newest summary of that call, blank = null). The call's REPORT never draws a row of its own (session-chat.json): every `report` card about a call session (a locked one too) is folded into its card as the caption (card.summary, else the message body when readable); an `event` line about a call session draws nothing. Tapping the card opens THE CALL VIEW of that session (`callView`, `callViewCases`): title = `call.viewTitle` with {duration} = `callLength` (running: `call.viewRunning` with {timer}); subtitle = `call.subtitle`: {when} · {agent} (the chat's agent name) with when = `call.when` {day} {start} – {end} (running: `call.whenRunning`), day = `call.today` on the viewer's local day of `startedAt`, else chats.json `chatTimeLabel` of it (Yesterday, a weekday, Mon D), start / end = local HH:mm of `startedAt` / `endedAt` (`utcOffsetMinutes`); then the summary under a section band labelled `call.summary` (none = no band); then the spoken turns as the chat's bubbles: the call session's own messages oldest first, cards and blank bodies dropped, the chat's copies (authorSessionId set, another session) dropped, the SERVER's lines dropped (a person message whose trimmed body matches one of `call.prompts` (the etalk `request`, `resumeText` and `endedText`, a drift test keeps them equal): each holds ONE {placeholder}; it matches when the body starts with the text before it, ends with the text after it and is longer than the two together), and the agent's first reply after a `call.prompts.ended` line is a SUMMARY (dropped from the turns; the newest one is the view's summary). A locked message is THE locked pill row (sealed-content.json), a locked summary reply draws nothing. Rows = session-chat.json `message` / `locked` rows (xref null). No spoken turn ever shows inline in the chat. THE LIVE CHAT (the Chat tab = the root's own session view, its device feed; transcript-grouping.json): a call's report reaches the chat's agent as a waking input the device words `Report from <name> (session <id>): <summary>` (a relay). `feedCallSession(text, callIds)` (`feedCases`) = that relay's session id when the input is a REPORT relay from a call session (`callIds` = the tree's call sessions), else null (a person's prompt, a marker, a `Message from` relay, a report from any other session). The feed draws such an input as THE call card of that session (`callCard`, caption = the newest such report body in the feed) at its FIRST report in the feed; every later report of the same call draws nothing (the card updates: a resumed call reads In a call again, then its new summary). A call session of the tree that is RUNNING and has no report in the loaded feed yet draws its card after the feed's last row (before the queued rows). Its relay bubble never shows; a `Message from` the call (work it hands to the chat) stays a relay bubble like any session's.
